comment: Test artifact manifest. Each entry names one artifact a test can consume, the environment
variable the test reads, the file name in the cache, its size and sha256 when pinned, and
where to obtain it. tools/fetch_test_artifacts.py populates the cache from this file.
A null sha256 or bytes means the entry is not pinned yet: the tool fetches it but cannot
verify it. Pin an entry once on a machine that has the artifact with
which copies it into the cache, records bytes+sha256 here, and leaves the artifact out of git.
A test whose entry is missing from the cache skips (exit 77) instead of failing.

fixtures.name: tiny_artifact
fixtures.purpose: Deterministic one-tensor v3 artifact for framing/codec tests. Regenerate with tests/fixtures/artifacts/make_tiny_artifact.py; the digest must not change.

fixtures.name: token_corpus
fixtures.purpose: First 2048 ids of the committed benchmark corpus; exact-prefill fixtures slice it. Provenance in tests/fixtures/corpus/manifest.json.
fixtures.consumer: host-only tests that need a fixed token stream

fixtures.name: prompt_corpus
fixtures.purpose: Eight fixed, model-agnostic prompts with budgets and coarse expectations; a GPU test that needs a prompt takes one from here instead of inventing a string.
fixtures.consumer: host-only tests that validate the fixture; GPU tests that read it

artifacts.name: exl3_codec_ground_truth
artifacts.notes: Ground truth of the EXL3 contract, generated once by tests/fixtures/exl3/generate_fixture.py and committed. The test already falls back to the committed path when the variable is unset, so this entry is documentation plus a digest.

artifacts.name: qwen3_8_27b_groupwise
artifacts.notes: Default for NINFER_TEST_ARTIFACT. Must carry the Vision component and the MTP head: vision_workspace and mtp_history need them.

artifacts.name: qwen3_8_27b_nvfp4

source.hint: the nvfp4 27B artifact; same test set as the groupwise one

artifacts.notes: Alternative to the default for the same NINFER_TEST_ARTIFACT tests; not a second default because one cache entry serves the variable.

artifacts.name: qwen3_6_35b_a3b

source.hint: the 35B-A3B MoE artifact with the DFlash v1 companion

artifacts.notes: The MoE and DFlash v1 tests need a 35B-A3B artifact, not a 27B one. Set NINFER_TEST_ARTIFACT to this entry's cache path to run them.

source.hint: 27B with MTP and the DFlash2 K=7 companion

artifacts.notes: speculative_invariant_real exercises MTP and DFlash2 on the same artifact; dflash2_real and dflash_prefill_real need the DFlash2 companion.

source.hint: the ~70 GiB Flash-Next artifact; needs the GB10 lane or a host-RAM tiered 5090 run

artifacts.notes: Does not fit a 32 GiB 5090 as one device; the 5090 lane skips these by design.

artifacts.name: qwen3_8_flash_next_125b_a6b_dflash2
artifacts.notes: load_plan reads both weight variables; it skips unless both are present.
